primaryChecks.text: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 初出節の地理用法を確認。常時表示の要約はこの節で確認できる内容に限定した。

primaryChecks.text: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。
